ios.desc:
Turn Fresh Content Into a Show That Sounds Like Yours

Radio Starlight turns feeds, APIs, public web pages, weather, and music into AI-powered radio shows and podcasts. Build a reusable format once, then generate new broadcasts from fresh source material while keeping the structure, voices, and sound unmistakably yours.

Start quickly with a Basic Program. For full creative control, use Pro to design a Custom Program segment by segment, from the opening and news desk to deep dives, music breaks, and the outro. Give each segment its own sources, prompts, personalities, and generative models, then reuse the format whenever new content arrives.

BUILD A FORMAT THAT STAYS YOURS

- Generate Basic Programs in a few taps.
- Arrange detailed Custom Programs and guide every segment with its own sources and prompts.
- Create on-air personalities and choose their voices.
- Pair shows with Sound Sets for background music and stingers.
- Create cover art and avatars for a consistent identity.

CONNECT THE CONTENT YOU FOLLOW

- Read RSS, Atom, and JSON feeds.
- Connect API content and public web pages.
- Include Apple Weather and Apple Music playlists when authorized.
- Choose cloud models or supported Apple on-device models for text and images.
- Store API credentials securely in Keychain.

STAY CURRENT WITHOUT STARTING OVER

- Create scripts and narrated broadcasts from your latest source material.
- Let Generate and Live sessions you start continue after you leave the app when iOS allows background processing.
- Find recent articles from your programs' feeds on Home.
- Browse featured catalogs when starting a new library.
- Keep Broadcast History manageable with optional automatic cleanup.

SHARE ON YOUR TERMS

Import programs, personalities, Sound Sets, and source definitions from portable catalogs. You can also export your own programs and generated assets through the open Starlight Catalog Service format, using static JSON and media that can be hosted anywhere. Publishing is optional and separate from everyday creation and playback.

START FREE, GO PRO WHEN READY

- Basic is free for creating and playing Basic Programs.
- Start a free 7-day Pro Trial to explore Custom Program creation and editing. The trial does not renew, and there is no automatic charge.
- Unlock Pro Lifetime with a one-time in-app purchase.
- Existing Pro access remains recognized.
- Restore purchases on devices using the same Apple ID.

YOUR TOOLS, YOUR CHOICES

You do not need a Radio Starlig
